profile.introduction: I work at the intersection of cinema, advertising and emerging technology. Turning an idea into a world you can see — and a story you can feel.
profile.biography: With a background in journalism and media, I bring a storyteller’s instinct to AI-powered production. My practice connects creative direction, generative imagery, filmmaking and digital content, from the first visual concept to the final frame.

services: Campaign ideas translated into striking visuals. From the first proposition to a distinctive commercial world.
Cinematic stories shaped through generative imagery, shot design, motion and a considered edit.
Original image worlds with a consistent visual language, developed around a clear creative intention.
The idea, the visual treatment and the decisions that make every frame belong to the same story.
Character concepts, expressive identities and visual consistency across scenes and formats.
Light, texture and movement that bring a product’s smallest details into focus.
Platform-conscious stories, built to catch attention and carry an idea in a short span of time.
Mood, narrative and art direction explored before production, so the story starts with intention.
process: Find the tension, the audience and the one thing the work needs to say.
Develop treatments, references, palettes and shot language.
Build images and sequences with intention, consistency and a critical eye.
Shape pacing, transitions, sound and the emotional arc of the film.
Finish the grade, polish the details and prepare the right formats.

projects.title: RRRR (India Today Group)
projects.subtitle: Raghupati Raghav Raja Ram
projects.description: A pilot AI micro-drama project for the India Today Group, reimagining the epic Ramayan through AI-powered filmmaking. The project explores generative AI for cinematic storytelling, character creation, and visual world-building, bringing mythology to life through an innovative digital format.

projects.title: TISSOT
projects.subtitle: Time, refined
projects.description: An independent visual concept exploring the quiet precision of time. Sculpted light, tactile surfaces and a moment held still. Not commissioned by or affiliated with Tissot.
